chapter: Wartime South and the Ernie Fields band
title: The club closes and the band breaks up
summary: The owner Mister Jones died and his niece closed the club; his grandmother fell ill and died.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: So we kept on. I worked there and worked there and worked there. And Mister Jones passed, who owned the club, and his niece was trying to run the place, and she couldn't really handle it, so she decided to give it up. So the band disbanded, and the place was shut down. And it wasn't too

long after that that my grandmother passed... Well, she was sick, and I had to go back to Jackson and spend some time with her. Then I had to go back shortly after that to the funeral. So I came back to Detroit, and...
